(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  simp only [Ne, ← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at hPP hPS

    refine ⟨fun hc ha => hPP A ha Aᶜ hc disjoint_compl_right, ?_⟩

    apply hPS ⟨Aᶜ, hc, ?_⟩
    intro U hu hAU
    apply hPS ⟨A, ha, ?_⟩
    intro V hv hAV
    exact hPP U hu V hv

  have hc : P.card = Pᶜ.card :=
    Finset.card_bijective compl compl_bijective (fun A => by simp [h])
  have hd : P.card + P.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    simpa only [← hc, Fintype.card_set] using Finset.card_add_card_compl P
  have hp : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel Fintype.card_pos]
  omega
